description: pLDDT and composition profiles of RDE-2/MUT-8
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq = open("rde2_Q19672.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
pl = np.load("plddt.npy")
L=len(seq); print(L, len(pl))

def frac(s, aas): return sum(s.count(a) for a in aas)/len(s) if s else 0
W=25; half=W//2
xs=np.arange(1,L+1)
def prof(aas, w=W):
    out=np.zeros(L)
    for i in range(L):
        a=max(0,i-w//2); b=min(L,i+w//2+1)
        out[i]=frac(seq[a:b],aas)
    return out
arom=prof("FWY"); pos=prof("KR"); neg=prof("DE"); qn=prof("QN"); sp=prof("STP"); gly=prof("G")
ncpr=pos-neg; fcr=pos+neg

fig,axes=plt.subplots(5,1,figsize=(13,13),sharex=True)
axes[0].plot(xs,pl,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1); axes[0].axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey"); axes[0].axhline(50,ls=":",c="grey")
axes[0].set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); axes[0].set_title("RDE-2/MUT-8 (Q19672, 578 aa): AlphaFold confidence and sequence composition (25-aa windows)")
axes[1].plot(xs,arom,c="#b7791f"); axes[1].set_ylabel("aromatic\n(F/W/Y)")
axes[2].plot(xs,qn,c="#6b46c1",label="Q+N"); axes[2].plot(xs,sp,c="#2f855a",label="S/T/P"); axes[2].legend(fontsize=8); axes[2].set_ylabel("Q/N and S/T/P")
axes[3].plot(xs,pos,c="#c53030",label="K+R"); axes[3].plot(xs,neg,c="#2c5282",label="D+E"); axes[3].legend(fontsize=8); axes[3].set_ylabel("charged")
axes[4].plot(xs,ncpr,c="k"); axes[4].axhline(0,c="grey",lw=0.6); axes[4].set_ylabel("NCPR"); axes[4].set_xlabel("residue")
for ax in axes:
    ax.axvspan(1,40,color="#f6e05e",alpha=.25)
    ax.axvspan(239,339,color="#90cdf4",alpha=.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nWhole protein composition:")
for lab,aas in [("aromatic FWY","FWY"),("Y","Y"),("K+R","KR"),("R","R"),("D+E","DE"),("Q+N","QN"),("Q","Q"),("S","S"),("P","P"),("G","G")]:
    print(f"  {lab:12s} {frac(seq,aas):.3f}")
print("\nN-terminal 1-40:", seq[:40])
for lab,aas in [("aromatic FWY","FWY"),("Y","Y"),("Q+N","QN"),("S+T+P","STP"),("charged DEKR","DEKR")]:
    print(f"  1-40  {lab:12s} {frac(seq[:40],aas):.3f}")
